cands.bio: Republican state representative for Alabama House District 29 (parts of Etowah and Calhoun counties) since November 2022. Pastor by profession. Graduated from Hokes Bluff High School. Serves on the Education Policy, Military and Veterans' Affairs, and Commerce and Small Business committees.
cands.gaps: We could not find Gidley's birthplace or the year he came to his current community, so his Alabama ties rest on his own description as a lifelong Etowah County resident. We found no details of his pastoral career, such as his church or years of service, and no record of a law, policy or budget career. The pages we had did not show the content of the bills he sponsored, so we could not confirm what any of them did. His campaign site lists the Military Spouse Licensing Act, the Elder Abuse Accountability Act, the School Chaplain Program Act and an assistant principal bill as achievements, but we could not verify their outcomes. We found no statements or actions from him on data centers, property taxes, land ownership by investors or foreigners, growth and land conservation, immigration or H-1B, gun laws, abortion, police pay, or school vouchers and teacher pay. We found no public stance on data centers or development, no controversies, no foreign ties, and no endorsements. Ballotpedia says he did not complete its candidate survey in 2022 or 2026.
